name: Defi Skills
description: Natural language to unsigned DeFi transactions. Translates natural language intents into transaction payloads. Deterministic, no signing, no private keys.
longDescription: This entry points at the repository's `.claude-plugin` folder itself, so installing it delivers only `marketplace.json` and `plugin.json`; the plugin proper is the repository root of NethermindEth/defi-skills, whose `plugin.json` names the skills under `.claude/skills`. Those skills translate natural-language intents ("supply 100 USDC to Aave") into unsigned, ABI-encoded transaction payloads across **13 protocols** (Aave, Lido, Uniswap, Curve, Compound, MakerDAO, Rocket Pool, EigenLayer, Balancer, Pendle, WETH, ERC-20, ERC-721) on 6 chains, resolving token symbols, ENS names and decimal amounts deterministically, with no signing and no private keys. The engine is the `defi-skills` Python package (`pip install defi-skills`). MIT.
